shots.beat: a bear and a dog sit relaxed by a green creek with fishing rods, calm and unhurried
a circus train stopped still on the tracks with thick dark smoke pouring up from it, seen across a valley
must_not: a train travelling normally and peacefully
a purely calm scenic postcard with nothing wrong

shots.beat: a horse-drawn wooden wagon moving fast along a dirt road with dust kicking up behind it
a bear and a dog standing in front of a weathered circus train whose doors are all shut, in harsh sunlight with dust and heat haze
must_not: animals leaning comfortably out of open windows
a cheerful train that appears to be running fine
the heroes standing around with nothing wrong

shots.beat: a bloodhound with his nose pressed against a narrow gap between the planks of a wooden boxcar door
a big bear leaning his shoulder and both paws into a boxcar door, body angled low, hind feet braced in the gravel, nothing in his paws
must_not: holding or using a stick, tool, rod or any object
sawdust or debris spraying out of the wall
poking, prying or fiddling at the wood

must_not: holding or using a stick, tool, rod or any object

shots.beat: one large amber elephant eye, wide open, seen through a narrow vertical gap between dark wooden planks
a wide open boxcar door with a young gray elephant wearing a small red circus cap standing in the opening in daylight
immediately after the rescue, at the train, the bear takes dry credit for having just forced the door open
must_not: standing in a forest or woods with no train anywhere
a location unrelated to the train

shots.beat: the sign-off at the end of the rescue, with the rescued circus train visible behind them as they head home
must_not: standing in a forest or woods with no train anywhere

spine.beat: a calm ordinary day is established so the interruption costs something
the heroes SEE that something is wrong — the call to adventure
they arrive at the broken-down train and the trouble is visible
we SEE who is trapped — the audience gets someone to root for
the effort: the door is forced with real physical weight
the bang is felt from inside the dark car
THE PAYOFF: the door opens and the trapped animal is free on screen
the goodbye, with the rescued train alive behind them
